fusions.name: Moonshot Drop
fusions.desc: Leaps onto a target up to 8 tiles away and deals 30 damage, up to 2 times that at the far end of the leap. It also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Ricochet Hop
fusions.desc: Pings a pellet that deals 7 damage, then hops to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles for 60% of that. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Across the Table
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 8 tiles away, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds after.

fusions.name: Landing Bite
fusions.desc: Every stretch of ground you cover makes your next ability deal 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
